step1.screen: simple plus button in home page
step1.description: this opens a modal to add a group name with default 'group 1' already in the input field. once the user enters a name and clicks on create, the group is created and the user is redirected to the group page

description.item1: show group name and a button to add members. the button should open up a modal to shows a qr code or a link to copy and share with friends.
description.item2: the group page should also show a list of members in the group
description.item3: the group page show button to add members, button to scan bill invoice/receipt and add scanned bill details to the group
description.item4: and show a split bill button to split the bill among members in the group by 50%, 20%, or any percent according to the number of members in the group
description.item5: the split bill button should open a modal to show the split bill details
description.item6: there should be a button to create a virtual wallet for the group. this should open a modal to show the wallet details like a card number, expiry date, and cvv. the user should be able to copy the card number and share it with friends to fund the wallet

step3.description: if you're the creator of the group, there should be a star beside your name to show that you're the creator of the group
